question.prompt: A city charges 2 yuan per tonne for monthly water usage up to 10 tonnes, and 3 yuan per tonne for the portion exceeding 10 tonnes. A household uses $x$ tonnes of water ($x>10$) and must pay $y$ yuan. Which expression gives $y$ as a function of $x$? ( )

solutions.explanation: The first 10 tonnes cost 20 yuan, and the excess $(x-10)$ tonnes cost 3 yuan per tonne: $y=20+3(x-10)=3x-10$.
solutions.title: Add the two pricing tiers
